properties.name: The Pearl Hoi An — 5BR Garden View Pool Villa
properties.fits_9: Single 5-bedroom villa sleeps 10 — whole family under one roof with private pool, full kitchen, near An Bang Beach; kids pool and restaurants on site.
properties.accessibility: Flat resort with paved paths and elevators in main blocks; ground-floor living. Confirm ground-floor bedroom for Nana at booking. Scooter-friendly grounds.

properties.name: Akala Villa Hoi An (6BR riverfront)
properties.fits_9: 6 double bedrooms sleep 12 — room for all three couples, the girls and Nana; 17m private pool, staff, breakfast, Thu Bon riverside 3km from Old Town.
properties.accessibility: Multi-storey house; email booking@akalavilla.com to confirm a step-free ground-floor bedroom. Flat riverside garden.

properties.name: Victoria Hoi An Beach Resort — 3 adjacent rooms
properties.fits_9: 3 adjacent Superior/Deluxe rooms (sleeps 2-3 + crib each); toddler cribs, playground, babysitting, private beach at Cua Dai.
properties.accessibility: Low-rise flat village-style resort ideal for the scooter; NO elevator — request ground-floor garden rooms (available).

properties.name: Almanity Hoi An Wellness Resort — 3 rooms
properties.fits_9: 3 adjacent rooms; daily spa treatment included in most rates; kids club, child pool, strollers, 10-min walk to Old Town.
properties.accessibility: Elevator serves most floors (NOT one 3rd-floor wing — insist on elevator-served or ground-floor rooms); flat resort core.

properties.name: Olala An Bang Villa (5BR)
properties.fits_9: 5 bedrooms, outdoor pool, BBQ, walk to An Bang Beach, 3.5km to Old Town — cheapest whole-house option for 9.
properties.accessibility: Ground-floor bedroom typical of the layout but unpublished — confirm step-free bedroom with host.

properties.name: Four Seasons The Nam Hai — 3 Family Villas
properties.fits_9: Purpose-built extended Family Villas (or the 5BR Beachfront Pool Villa with personal attendant); superb kids programme.
properties.accessibility: Accessibility gold standard: every villa single-storey at ground level, flat resort, buggy service everywhere. Step-free entries on request.

properties.name: Anantara Hoi An Resort — 2x 2BR River Suites
properties.fits_9: Two-Bedroom River Suites sleep 4-5 each; the only luxury resort walkable to the Old Town lanterns.
properties.accessibility: Colonial low-rise with NO elevator — request ground-floor suites (available); flat riverside gardens.

properties.name: The Pearl Hoi An — 5BR Beachfront Pool Villa
properties.fits_9: Seafront 5-bedroom estate villa sleeping 10, private pool + kitchen; steps to An Bang sand plus full resort facilities.
properties.accessibility: Same flat grounds/elevators as garden villa; request ground-floor bedroom; beachfront deck is level.

activities.name: Red Bridge Cooking School — market, river boat + class
activities.ages: All ages; hands-on for Naeema and Amirah
activities.accessibility: Flat riverside campus; scooter user should request road transfer instead of boat gangway (offered)

activities.name: Tra Que Herb Village — cooking class + farming
activities.ages: All ages — kids plant herbs and water gardens
activities.accessibility: Flat lanes; scooter fine on main paths

activities.name: Lantern-Making Workshop, Old Town
activities.ages: Ages 3+; take home a foldable silk lantern
activities.accessibility: Ground-level studios; 'Lantern Lady' class explicitly wheelchair accessible

activities.name: Bay Mau Coconut Forest basket boats
activities.ages: All ages incl. Aliya — calm shallow water, infant life jackets
activities.accessibility: Boat transfer needs lifting assist; Nana can watch from the shaded riverside deck

activities.name: My Son Sanctuary half-day tour
activities.accessibility: NOT scooter accessible (operator states explicitly) — Nana skips or waits at visitor center

activities.name: Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge day trip
activities.ages: All ages; long day — tiring for the toddler
activities.accessibility: Cable cars board scooters with staff assist; some zones have stairs — partial

activities.name: Shore Club — An Bang Beach day
activities.accessibility: Level deck from drop-off; sand beyond deck not scooter-passable — Nana gets the ocean-view deck

activities.name: The DeckHouse — beach club with pool
activities.ages: All ages — the pool is the toddler-safest swim when winter sea is rough
activities.accessibility: Level deck and pool access from parking

notes: Dec–Feb is dry/peak season — add 10-20% where marked estimate. Tet (early-mid Feb 2027) = Vietnam's biggest holiday: surcharges + closures, book 4-6 months out. Victoria Hoi An charges a compulsory NYE gala supplement Dec 31 (~$88/adult). Winter sea at An Bang can be rough for a toddler — villa pools or DeckHouse pool are the safer swim. Old Town is pedestrianized and flat — excellent scooter terrain (Japanese Covered Bridge has steps).
